declarations.type:
∀ {Identity Payload : Type} {cycle : SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.GcCycle Identity} {commitEpoch : Nat}
  {record : SearchRouteAdmissionHistory.AdmissionRecord Identity}
  {before after : SearchRouteAdmissionRetention.ReceiptStore Identity Payload},
  SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.ConcurrentCommitCertificate cycle commitEpoch record →
    SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.SafeSweep cycle before after →
      after record.baselineReceiptIdentity = before record.baselineReceiptIdentity ∧
        after record.extendedReceiptIdentity = before record.extendedReceiptIdentity
declarations.name: SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.barrier_safe_sweep_preserves_concurrent_commit_receipts

declarations.type:
∀ {Identity : Type} {cycle : SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.GcCycle Identity} {commitEpoch : Nat}
  {record : SearchRouteAdmissionHistory.AdmissionRecord Identity},
  SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.ConcurrentCommitCertificate cycle commitEpoch record →
    cycle.remembered record.baselineReceiptIdentity ∧ cycle.remembered record.extendedReceiptIdentity
declarations.name: SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.publication_during_sweep_requires_both_barrier_entries

declarations.type:
∀ {Identity : Type} {before after : SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.GcCycle Identity}
  {record : SearchRouteAdmissionHistory.AdmissionRecord Identity},
  SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.RememberedSetMonotone before after →
    SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.BarrierCovers before record → SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.BarrierCovers after record
declarations.name: SearchRouteAdmissionGcBarrier.remembered_set_monotonicity_preserves_installed_barrier
